text: Read carefully the transcript of a radio broadcast about people’s attitudes to animals in the
Reading Booklet Insert. Then answer Section 1, Question 1 on this Question Paper.
You have been asked to write a speech to broadcast in response.
Write the words of your speech.
• identify and evaluate arguments in the transcript
• explain why you do or do not agree with the broadcaster’s views.
Base your speech on what you have read in the transcript. Be careful to use your own words.

Descriptive Writing

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe a small group of people relaxing, and then the moment that destroys the atmosphere
of calm.
OR

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Describe a party in full swing, and then what the place is like when all the visitors have gone
home.
Narrative Writing

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Write a story called ‘The Path that led to Nowhere’.
OR

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Write a story that involves your attempt to cook a meal for others.
